name: Hive 1.4.5
notes: Sync resilience: the relay client now uses TCP keepalive + a short idle-pool timeout so a connection that dies during sleep or a network blip is dropped and the next request opens a fresh one — sync self-heals instead of erroring until you restart. People pane: your own membership now shows as a 'You' row (a solo/owned workspace no longer reads as '0 people'), and a clear note appears when you aren't in a workspace's roster.
